description: Sync a Klaviyo account's campaigns, flows, lists, segments, email templates and subscriber profiles, one document per record.
opening: Sync a Klaviyo account's campaigns, flows, lists, segments, email templates and subscriber profiles. Each record is one document of `Label: value` lines. Templates also carry their email content as text, and profiles carry their location and custom properties.

Klaviyo permissions are not imported, so every synced item is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. That includes profiles, whose email, phone number and custom properties are searchable. List and segment membership is not synced, and records are not linked to each other. Records deleted in Klaviyo stay in HydraDB.

connect.auth: Klaviyo uses a private API key.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste a Klaviyo private API key as `auth_token`.

steps.title: Configure the connector
steps.text: HydraDB lists one account-wide resource, All data. Select it to sync the whole account the key belongs to.

connect.account: One connector reads one Klaviyo account, the one the key belongs to.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default, by each record's last update time. A record not updated within that window is not synced until it changes.
sync.changes: Each sync reads records whose update time moved past the last sync.
sync.edits: An edited record replaces its document.
sync.deletes: Deleted records are not removed. A record deleted in Klaviyo stays searchable in HydraDB.
notes: A record with no readable update time is skipped.
Campaigns on a channel Klaviyo reports as unsupported are skipped.

shared_attributes.name: Record attributes
shared_attributes.text: Every non-empty attribute with a single value, in alphabetical order as `Label: value`, such as names, statuses, personal details and dates. The `html`, `text`, `company_id`, `message` and `image` attributes are left out of this list.

shared_attributes.name: updated_at, updated
shared_attributes.text: When the record was last updated. It sets the result date. When it is one of the record's attributes, it is part of the text too.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.klaviyo_id
shared_attributes.text: The Klaviyo id of the record. Targets one record. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's records. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: stream_type
shared_attributes.text: The record type, such as `campaigns` or `profiles`, shown when you inspect the item. No published filter limits a query by record type.

shared_attributes.name: Nested details
shared_attributes.text: Nested values of the record, such as audiences, and relationships such as list and segment membership. Kept for inspection only. They are not searchable and do not link records to each other.

documents.name: Campaigns, flows, lists and segments
documents.one_document: One campaign, flow, list or segment. Campaigns cover the email, SMS and mobile push channels.
documents.title: The record's name, or `Klaviyo <record type> <id>` when there is none.
documents.text: The title, then the record's attributes as `Label: value` lines.
documents.date: When the record was last updated.
documents.link_back: The record's address in Klaviyo's API, not a page in the Klaviyo app.

attributes.name: name
attributes.text: The record's name, written as the title and as an attribute line.

documents.name: Email templates
documents.title: The template's name, or `Klaviyo templates <id>` when there is none.
documents.text: The title, the template's attributes as `Label: value` lines, then the email content.
documents.date: When the template was last updated.
documents.link_back: The template's address in Klaviyo's API, not a page in the Klaviyo app.

attributes.name: html, text
attributes.text: The email content: the HTML converted to text, or the plain-text version when there is no HTML.

documents.name: Profiles
documents.title: The person's first and last name, else their email, else `Klaviyo profiles <id>`.
documents.text: The title, the profile's attributes as `Label: value` lines, such as email and phone number, then a `Location` line and the custom properties.
documents.date: When the profile was last updated.
documents.link_back: The profile's address in Klaviyo's API, not a page in the Klaviyo app.

attributes.name: location
attributes.text: City, region and country, written as `Location: city, region, country`. Other location details are not searchable.

attributes.name: properties
attributes.text: Every non-empty custom property with a single value, in order of property name, as `Label: value`. Custom properties whose value is an object or a list are not searchable.

example_searches: What does the Welcome Series email template say?
Which flows are live, and when were they last updated?
What city, region and country are recorded for jane@example.com?

connections: None. Campaigns are not linked to their templates, and profiles are not linked to their lists or segments.
graph.people: No people are attached to items. A profile's name and email are part of its text only.
graph.from_text: The attribute lines of every record, template email content, and profile locations and custom properties. List membership and other relationships are not in the text, so they cannot be found there.

not_synced: Events, such as opens, clicks and orders, and metrics.
Campaign messages and subject lines. Template content is synced as templates.
Klaviyo reports, such as campaign values and flow series.
Records not updated within the first sync window, until they change.
Deletions: records deleted in Klaviyo stay in HydraDB.
